--- title: "Physicochemical characterisation" subtitle: "Sequence-only descriptors for in-house binder designs" --- ::: {.caveat} **These are descriptors, not predictions.** Nothing in this track is fitted, trained, or correlated against the experimental outcome columns. The experimental metadata travels alongside the descriptors so a human can look at both; no relationship between them is computed or implied. Several of these descriptors — the instability and aliphatic indices especially — are literature heuristics with weak, context-dependent relevance to recombinant expression in *E. coli*, and are not quality scores. ::: ## What this computes ::: {#0f1a7997 .cell execution_count=2} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display .cell-output-markdown execution_count=2} Sequence-only properties for each binder ([2026-11-05T0754Z_physchem_descriptors-10binders](../runs/2026-11-05T0754Z_physchem_descriptors-10binders/)): length, molecular weight, pI, net charge at pH 7.0 and 8.0, GRAVY, instability and aliphatic indices, aromaticity with explicit F/W/Y counts, cysteine count and parity, the full 20-residue composition as percentages, charged fraction over DEKR, reduced and oxidised extinction coefficients at 280 nm, Shannon entropy of composition (base 2), longest run of AVILMFWYC, and the maximum mean Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy over a 9-residue window with its position. 65 columns, 20 rows: 10 binders x 2 construct forms. 0 sequences rejected on validation. ::: ::: A structural tier (SASA, secondary structure, structure-corrected solubility) and an ESM2 embedding tier are planned as additional stages contributing their own columns to the same table. Neither is implemented. The embedding tier is blocked on a [decision about its role](../decisions.qmd#esm2-role). ## Verification before use ::: {#c064c18c .cell execution_count=3} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display .cell-output-markdown execution_count=3} The implementation was checked against independently known values before it was run on real sequences ([2026-11-05T0749Z_physchem_smoketest](../runs/2026-11-05T0749Z_physchem_smoketest/)): **66 checks, 0 failures**. | Quantity | Published (ProtParam) | Computed | Tolerance | |---|---|---|---| | Molecular weight | 8564.84 Da | 8564.7357 Da | ±0.5 | | Isoelectric point | 6.56 | 6.5616 | ±0.2 | | Extinction at 280 nm | 1490 M⁻¹cm⁻¹ | 1490 M⁻¹cm⁻¹ | exact | Reference protein: bovine-ubiquitin-P0CG53-1-76. Edge cases covered a 5-residue peptide, zero-cysteine and zero-aromatic sequences (extinction coefficient must be exactly 0), an all-alanine sequence, and rejection of sequences containing X or a hyphen. The pI tolerance is 0.2 pH units because Biopython's pKa table differs slightly from the ExPASy web implementation. ::: ::: ## Tag handling, and why there are two rows per binder ::: {#8f8c2a6e .cell execution_count=4} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display .cell-output-markdown execution_count=4} Purification tags and expression leaders change every number above, and this set mixes tagged and untagged constructs. Each binder therefore appears twice: `as_given` and `tag_stripped`. Stripping removes a terminal run of ≥ 6 H at either terminus, a leading ['MGSS', 'MGS', 'M'] leader (longest match first), and a GS-rich linker of ≥ 3 residues **only** where directly adjacent to a removed tag. 7 of 10 binders had something removed. ::: ::: ::: {#0404cd8d .cell execution_count=5} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=5} ```{=html}

Practically: A280 will quantify it poorly. - **MMP9B9** has an instability index of 84.8, nearly double the median of 45.4. - All 10 binders have an **even** cysteine count, and 7 have none at all. GRAVY is negative for every one, so all are net hydrophilic. ::: ::: ## Descriptors against observed outcomes: a sanity check, not a result ::: {.caveat} **This cannot be evidence.** 10 binders, with 2 non-expressers, 3 pellet and 5 supernatant cases. No p-value or correlation coefficient against any outcome column has been computed, and none should be. What follows checks that the pipeline produces sane numbers and that the descriptors are not secretly encoding the answer. ::: ::: {#20139906 .cell execution_count=12} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=12} ```{=html}

Two of the three pellet cases are the nanobody-format IL10 constructs, which differ from the helical designs in format, length and origin — so the split is confounded with construct class, not just with these descriptors. The instability index runs **opposite** to the folklore, being lower in the insoluble group (37.8–46.5) than in the soluble one (44.3–84.8). None of this is a signal. ::: ::: ### IL6P233 versus IL6AD15 ::: {#467c98b4 .cell execution_count=14} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display .cell-output-markdown execution_count=14} These two share their C-terminal 30 residues (verified identical from the sequences in the output table: **True**) and differ across their N-terminal 60. IL6P233 did not express; IL6AD15 expressed and was mostly soluble. Both were tried at 37 °C, and the notes record no 30 °C attempt for IL6P233. ::: ::: ::: {#46014f3a .cell execution_count=15} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=15} ```{=html}
